SocialSchemeSettlement.title: SocialSchemeSettlement
SocialSchemeSettlement.description: Network-agnostic generic layer. Models the financial settlement record for a social-scheme facilitation service: what was collected from the applicant (if anything), when, and via which payment channel. Inherits from Beckn core Attributes. The ION-specific layer (IONSocialSchemeSettlementAttributes) extends this via allOf and carries Indonesian payment rail and regulatory fields.

IONSocialSchemeSettlementAttributes.description:
Indonesia-specific settlement record for a social-scheme facilitation
service. Covers facilitation fee collection (when non-zero) and
government fee passthroughs. The government benefit disbursement itself
is never routed through this record — it is tracked in
Performance.disbursement and delivered directly by the implementing agency.

settlementType.description: Whether a fee was collected for facilitation services, or whether the facilitation was provided free of charge. FREE means no money changed hands between the applicant and the facilitation partner. FACILITATION_FEE means a fee was collected as declared in the linked Offer and Consideration. GOVERNMENT_FEE_PASSTHROUGH means a statutory government fee (e.g. a document-issuance charge mandated by the scheme itself) was collected and will be remitted to the government — not retained by the facilitation partner.

totalAmount.description: Total amount collected from the applicant in IDR. Zero for FREE settlement type. Must match the sum of Consideration lines for non-zero settlements.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Fixed at IDR for all domestic ION transactions.

paymentStatus.description: Status of the facilitation fee payment, when settlementType is FACILITATION_FEE or GOVERNMENT_FEE_PASSTHROUGH. NOT_APPLICABLE for FREE settlements.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used to collect the facilitation fee, when settlementType is not FREE. References the same payment method enum as the ION core PaymentDeclaration schema.

paidAt.description: Timestamp at which the facilitation fee was successfully collected, in UTC with timezone offset. Present only when paymentStatus is PAID.

gatewayRef.description: Payment gateway transaction reference, when a digital payment method was used to collect the facilitation fee.

remittanceStatus.description: Status of the government fee remittance to the implementing agency, applicable only when settlementType is GOVERNMENT_FEE_PASSTHROUGH. Tracks whether the collected government fee has been forwarded.

remittanceRef.description: Official government receipt or remittance reference number confirming that a collected government fee passthrough has been forwarded to the implementing agency. Required when remittanceStatus is REMITTED.

refundRecord.description: Present when paymentStatus is REFUNDED. Documents the refund of a previously collected facilitation fee — for example, when the facilitation partner offers refundOnRejection=true and the government application was rejected.

FacilitationRefund.description: Record of a facilitation fee refund to the applicant. Present on a Settlement record when paymentStatus transitions to REFUNDED. Captures the refund amount, reason, timing, and method, consistent with the Offer.refundOnRejection promise declared at catalog time.

refundAmount.description: Amount refunded to the applicant in IDR.

refundReason.description: Why the facilitation fee was refunded.

refundMethod.description: Channel through which the refund was returned to the applicant.
